notices.short_title: 82627P0002-BEPA: GI-PSE 1-3 Design Services Task Order Contract for Green Infrastructure in NYC Parks & City-owned Street Ends
notices.description: The City of New York has a combined sewer system serving approximately one third of the city. During rain events, rainfall is transmitted to the water bodies surrounding the City with limited water quality treatment, contributing to water quality impacts in the receiving water bodies. The scope of GI-PSE 1, 2 and 3 contracts are to design an extensive system of GI practices in NYC Parks and Publicly owned street ends to capture and manage stormwater runoff from impervious surfaces top meet Consent Order requirements. These practices include but are not limited to bioretention systems, permeable pavement, synthetic turf, wetlands, green roofs, subsurface detention/retention systems, and/or any combination thereof. This Request for Proposal (RFx) is being released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal at https://www.nyc.gov/site/mocs/passport/about-passport.pageand click on the Search Funding Opportunities in PASSPort blue box. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate t…

notices.description: PS-318: Reconstruction of Paerdegat Pumping Station Paerdegat pumping station is located in Brooklyn, New York at 6002 Flatlands Ave, Brooklyn, New York that flows to the Coney Island Wastewater Resource Recovery Facility. The Pumping Station was constructed in 1932 with an upgrade completed in 1995. The station currently has a designed flow capacity of 57 million gallons per day (MGD) wet weather flow and 22.8 MGD dry weather flow. The existing station is in need of State of Good Repair (SOGR) upgrades in order to improve compliance with DEPs SOPs and design guidelines. Specifically, areas needing SOGR improvements include replacing existing pumps, placing wet well elevation monitoring system, new mechanical, HVAC, electrical, I&C systems, resiliency upgrades, provide permanent emergency fuel generator and fuel storage, replace crane electrification system, rehab wet well structure, reconstruction of floors, walls, and ceilings, replace clay tile and membrane roofing, replace building façade walls, windows, floors, and brick fence, replace plumbing and fixtures in bathroom, replace existing force main, install new parallel force main, extend spillway, replace the gate wall thim…
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking bids from pre-qualified contractors to reconstruct the Paerdegat Pumping Station in Brooklyn, with responses due Dec. 16, 2026.

notices.short_title: 81627Y0873-Assays, reagents, and consumables for cobas® 5800, 6800v2, 8800v2, MagNa Pure96, and LightCycler systems
notices.description:
Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board Rules, the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) intends to enter into negotiations for a six-year Sole Source agreement with Roche Diagnostic Corporation to procure assays, reagents, and consumables for the cobas® 5800, 6800v2, 8800v2, MagNa Pure96, and LightCycler systems. The cobas® 5800, 6800 and 8800 systems are automated Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) test systems for high volume and high throughput molecular testing. Assays on these instruments include the only high-throughput HIV-1/2 qualitative nucleic acid amplification test, testing for STIs including Trichomonas, M. Gen and HPV, bloodborne pathogens like HBV and Hepatitis C Virus (HCV), and an expanding Research Use Only (RUO) panel.

The MagNA Pure96 is a high throughput DNA and RNA extraction platform that enables extraction of nearly 100 samples simultaneously. The LightCycler® system is a quantitative PCR system with associated reagents. This system allows for laboratory developed test creation for molecular detection of novel pathogens. These instruments and kit…

notices.short_title: COMPASS Programs in Public Schools - Middle
notices.description: COMPASS and SONYC is one of DYCD's largest programs, with over 820 programs collectively throughout the five boroughs. Families rely on these programs to provide elementary and middle school students, during after school hours, summer and on holidays, programing which includes educational support, recreation, enrichment, and cultural activities to support and strengthen the overall development of our youth. Programs are offered at no cost to youth and are purposefully located in public and private schools, community centers, religious institutions, public housing and parks recreational facilities throughout the City to help families find a place that best fits their youth's needs.

notable.short_title: COMPASS Programs in Public Schools - Middle
notable.description: COMPASS and SONYC is one of DYCD's largest programs, with over 820 programs collectively throughout the five boroughs. Families rely on these programs to provide elementary and middle school students, during after school hours, summer and on holidays, programing which includes educational support, recreation, enrichment, and cultural activities to support and strengthen the overall development of our youth. Programs are offered at no cost to youth and are purposefully located in public and private schools, community centers, religious institutions, public housing and parks recreational facilities throughout the City to help families find a place that best fits their youth's needs.
notable.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded KIPP Academy Charter School a $3.2 million contract, chosen from competing proposals and a pre-qualified list, to run COMPASS after-school, summer and holiday programs for middle school students in public schools.

notable.short_title: 81627Y0873-Assays, reagents, and consumables for cobas® 5800, 6800v2, 8800v2, MagNa Pure96, and LightCycler systems
notable.description:
Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board Rules, the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) intends to enter into negotiations for a six-year Sole Source agreement with Roche Diagnostic Corporation to procure assays, reagents, and consumables for the cobas® 5800, 6800v2, 8800v2, MagNa Pure96, and LightCycler systems. The cobas® 5800, 6800 and 8800 systems are automated Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) test systems for high volume and high throughput molecular testing. Assays on these instruments include the only high-throughput HIV-1/2 qualitative nucleic acid amplification test, testing for STIs including Trichomonas, M. Gen and HPV, bloodborne pathogens like HBV and Hepatitis C Virus (HCV), and an expanding Research Use Only (RUO) panel.

The MagNA Pure96 is a high throughput DNA and RNA extraction platform that enables extraction of nearly 100 samples simultaneously. The LightCycler® system is a quantitative PCR system with associated reagents. This system allows for laboratory developed test creation for molecular detection of novel pathogens. These instruments and kit…
notable.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene intends to negotiate a six-year sole-source agreement with Roche Diagnostic Corporation for assays, reagents and supplies for its laboratory testing systems, with responses due Nov. 2, 2026.

notable.plain: The New York City Police Department intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Fisher Scientific Company LLC (Thermo Fisher) to buy eight Nicolet Apex FTIR Spectrometers, instruments used to analyze cocaine caseload and training samples, with responses due Nov. 4, 2026.
